capabilities: Render a tabs code block as switchable tab panes in reading view
Separate and label tabs with ---tab / ---tab* syntax
Insert a complete tabs block template from the command palette
Autocomplete ---tab separators while typing inside a tabs block
Lazy-render tab content on first activation and drag-scroll overflowing tab bars
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Manual installation instructions are provided, plus installation via BRAT from the repository QuincySx/obsidian-markdown-tabs. The README is bilingual (English and Chinese).
problem: Markdown has no built-in way to show alternative content (like multiple diagrams or code variants) in switchable tabs within a note.
summary: Renders fenced tabs code blocks as switchable tab panes in Obsidian's reading view, with lazy rendering and typing aids.
